Messages.Author: vermillian
Messages.Body:
I Riposte during the second round of combat and then Telepathic
Tracking. Does the opposing minion take the damage from Riposte still?

I don't know WHY I still can't figure out this and get things
straight...

~SV

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No.

Effects that end combat and then do something else after combat (all in the
single resolution of the effect) will fizzle if combat doesn't end or if a
new combat is started.
